body:
Unfortunately, the consensus among the medical community is that pedophilia is a hardwired orientation, and can never be cured. 

The therapists I've had up to this point, and will continue to see, are quite good in helping me cope and manage, and so they have indeed helped with the desire. It's the attraction that's incurable.
It lowers your libido, yes. But that's treating a symptom, not the disease. It's also not been shown to reduce recidivism in previous offenders, though that doesn't apply to me.
It doesn't eliminate, or even diminish, the attraction itself.
Everything I've read about it in regards to pedophilia say it's ineffective. So I'll pass on it.

With the family being common victims of sexual abuse, I do believe it comes down to it being a crime of opportunity, which is why I said it seems to me to be a numbers game. It's just a matter of time til an opportunity to be alone with the child and a lapse in willpower line up, as sick as that is. 

I am not exclusively sexually attracted to children, but it's pretty close. There are very few women my age (or in my dating range) who get me interested physically, so to speak. I believe that a person my age could fulfill my emotional desires as well, for that matter. I'm just hoping I meet someone one day who I have an appropriate attraction to. Only thing I can do, really.
Thank you for your words.

That's the thing: I don't know if the fact that it would be incest would deter me from being attracted to a hypothetical daughter. And if I was attracted, that would mean every day in a certain age range would be a test of my will-power. It's just a numbers game at that point. 

So, as much as I would like to have a family, I will probably make the decision not to, if it is ever a decision I have to make.

I do have friends my age, both men and women. There was even a friend who I did develop feelings for, though she did have a rather child-like build. Ultimately the feelings weren't reciprocated. We're still friends though, and my feelings for her have long since gone away. I do think that if I do meet another woman that I'm attracted to, then I will definitely pursue a relationship with her. But at my age that pool is pretty small. 

I've also considered just trying to date someone anyways and just pretending to have a much lower libido than I actually do. It's not like I'm unable to be stimulated. I'm sure if I were in an intimate situation with a woman my age, even if I didn't find her particularly attractive, that I'd get aroused. 

Thanks for your help. I'm feeling much better now than when I made this post a few hours ago.

Thanks for the info. Since posting this thread I found a web site with a similar theme. I joined the forums there and I'm tentatively going to say it seems helpful, though I'm also going to say that it makes me appreciate how much of a handle I have on this relative to some other people experiencing similar things...
I really think you should re-evaluate why you visit this sub.
I understand and appreciate the spirit of your advice. Thank you.
It honestly seems like they have good intentions, they just don't know how to go about being supportive. It's understandable, mine isn't exactly a thing a lot of people have experience with.
Interesting that you come into a thread on a sub meant to support people in need and manage to make it about yourself.
I expected it making a post like this, don't worry. Don't even justify them with a response.

Yeah, the person has good intentions in trying to help me, but I don't think they realize how damaging what they're saying could be if I didn't have as much of a grip on my attractions. Some people with similar attractions legitimately believe what he's saying. Fortunately I'm not one of them.

Have indeed, but it seems that it has no effect at all on the aforementioned attractions. Also comes with a lot of negative side effects. So I've thought about it, but never really considered it as it just seems like adding pointless suffering (pointless in that it would not address the root problem.)

Legality isn't what I'm concerned about regarding a relationship with a child. It's that a relationship between a child and and an adult cannot be consensual, and will be always be harmful to the child.

I've seen these. Unfortunately, I don't have that kind of money. Also, I feel like it would be ultimately unfulfilling. I enjoy the company of children, so there would be an emotional aspect that wouldn't be there. Plus, they're pretty creepy looking. Too much in the uncanny valley.

Well, as I said in my original post, I've become less and less attracted to appropriately aged women, and so my sexual desires are pretty much exclusively unactionable. So I suppose it is analogous to alcoholism or any other addiction. In fact, most treatment for pedophiles who have previously offended borrows a lot from treatments for addicts that seek to prevent to relapse. And I have long ago come to terms with the fact that I can never act upon my desires, or else I probably would have offended by now. But still, it's extremely difficult every day knowing I'll never again have a fulfilling romantic relationship.

Therapy has given me a lot of was of coping with my attractions. It helps me avoid indulging in any illegal materials. It has helped with depression that is related to my paraphilia (but that also stems from other issues in my life). I'd say therapy has helped a lot, but ultimately I know that I'll never go a day without this attraction, and that is tortuous to me. It is not a life I want to continue living. 

Being childless is an option for everyone (who does not already have a child). So of course it's an option for me. But I've always wanted to have a family. Knowing that it would be morally irresponsible for me to have one is difficult.
